description: This PHP test class, EmailSubscriberAPITest, contains unit tests for the EmailSubscriberAPI related to email subscription management. It tests retrieving all email subscribers, a single subscriber, creating, updating, and deleting email subscriptions within the admin API module.

classes.name: EmailSubscriberAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing CRUD operations and retrieval functionalities of the EmailSubscriberAPI within the OrangeHRM admin API module.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all email subscribers via the API.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single email subscriber by ID via the API.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new email subscription via the API.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing email subscription via the API.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting an email subscription via the API.
